# Poly Haven assets (CC0)

All models and textures in this folder come from [Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com) and are
released under **CC0 1.0** (public domain): free for any use, commercial or personal, with no
attribution required. Credit is given here anyway, with thanks to the Poly Haven team and artists.

Downloaded by `tools/fetch_polyhaven.py` (1k resolution; JPG maps instead of EXR).
